sections.title: Game Time
items: Max 50 minutes
2×25 mins

sections.title: Ball
items: Size 4

sections.title: Goalkeepers
items: Yes

sections.title: Subs
items: Max 3
Rolling rotation encouraged

sections.title: Start & Restart of Play
items: Kick to a teammate from halfway.
Opposition must be 5m away.
Cannot score directly from kick‑off — ball must touch another player.
After a goal, the conceding team restarts from halfway.

sections.title: Scoring
items: A goal is scored when the whole ball crosses the line.

sections.title: Retreating Line
items: Used for: Goal kicks; Goalkeeper possession; Free kicks.
Opposition must drop behind the retreating line.
They may advance only after: the goalkeeper plays the ball; and a teammate touches it.
Coaches should encourage quick play from the goalkeeper.

sections.title: Offside
items: Offside applies.
For 9th & 10th Grade: Offside is judged between the retreating line and the goal line only.

sections.title: Ball Out of Play – Touch Line
items: Throw‑ins: Both feet on or behind the line.
Throw‑ins: Ball delivered with both hands from behind and over the head.
Throw‑ins: Thrower cannot touch the ball again until another player does.
Throw‑ins: Cannot score directly from a throw‑in.

sections.title: Ball Out of Play – Goal Line
items: Defending team last touched: Corner kick.
Attacking team last touched: Goal kick from anywhere inside the penalty area.
Opponents retreat to the retreating line.

sections.title: Goalkeepers
items: May handle the ball anywhere inside the penalty area.
Must release the ball within 6 seconds.
Must throw, roll, or play from the ground — no drop‑kicks or punts.
Indirect free kick if the keeper handles a deliberate back‑pass.

sections.title: Fouls & Misconduct
items: Mostly indirect free kicks, except for penalties.
Opponents must be 5m away.
Fouls include: Kicking, tripping, jumping at, charging, striking; pushing, holding, spitting; deliberate handball; dangerous play; impeding progress.

sections.title: Penalty kicks
items: Awarded for deliberate handball or serious misconduct in the penalty area.
Taken from 7m with a goalkeeper in position.

sections.title: Match Results & Ladders
items: No public results, tables, or ladders.
Results may be recorded privately to help place teams at appropriate levels.
